description: 'You have 10 days … to return your form' is the reader's deadline even with no calendar date.

input.text:
CEDAR COUNTY BENEFITS
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Due dates:
You have 10 days from the date of this notice to return your form.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
